_readme: Machine-readable project status. Read this at the start of a session to orient; update it at the end of any task that changes what's built or what's broken. Prose belongs in the docs — this file is the ledger. Status values: not_started | in_progress | complete | blocked.

phase_0_skeleton.notes: Done: pyproject.toml, models.py, config.py (pydantic-settings, TOML + VHFWATCH_* env override), structlog setup (log.py), store/schema.sql (all 11 tables, append-only triggers) + store/db.py (WAL, user_version migrations), tests for config and store. Remaining: FileAudioSource, segmenter, the four segmenter fixture tests, scripts/audio_devices.py, pipeline entry point. Exit criterion: the pipeline segments a WAV into transmissions in SQLite with audio on disk, and the four required segmenter fixture cases pass. See docs/roadmap.md.

phase_1_transcription_detection.notes: ASR implementations, hallucination filter, watchwords, LLM classification, correlator, evaluate.py. This is the phase that determines whether the project is viable — if precision is unusable here, no amount of later polish fixes it.

phase_2_live_audio.notes: Blocked on hardware bring-up, not on code. Do not start debugging software against live audio before docs/hardware.md §5 Step 4 passes.

phase_3_alerting_and_record.notes: Alert channels, router, FastAPI incident record, waveform UI, useful/not-useful feedback.

phase_4_reliability.notes: Watchdog, heartbeats, no-transmission alert, noise-floor drift, daily self-test, systemd units, x86 Linux verification.

phase_5_tuning.notes: Incident review with Parker, threshold retuning against real feedback labels, lead-time statistics.

corpus_collection.notes: Real Ch 16 audio accumulates in wall-clock time and cannot be rushed later. Start recording as soon as ANY audio input works — this is the highest-value thing that can be happening in the background at all times. Corpus is shareable between rigs; calibration values are not (docs/decisions.md D11).

bringup_log.notes: docs/bringup-log.md is an empty template. No session has been recorded for either rig.

andy_m2.notes: Has a hardware input trim. Watch for the balanced-input phase-cancellation trap (docs/hardware.md §3.4).

parker_uca202.notes: No hardware input trim — the front knob is headphone output only. The radio's volume knob may be the only analog control, with input_gain_db as a post-capture last resort.

known_issues.description: No audio code exists yet. The skeleton (models, config, store) is real and tested, but audio/, asr/, detect/, and the pipeline entry point are still specification only.

Neither rig's audio chain has been verified end to end. The bring-up procedure in docs/hardware.md §5 has not been run, so all segmenter thresholds in docs/architecture.md §5.2 are starting guesses derived from theory, not from a measured noise floor.

ASR model choice (base.en / small.en / medium.en) is unresolved. docs/architecture.md says start with small.en, but the decision is supposed to be made on measured WER against the real corpus, and the corpus does not exist yet.

open_questions: What is the actual traffic volume on Ch 16 at the POC site? This sets the 'no transmission in N hours' watchdog threshold (Phase 4 starts at 6 hours as a placeholder) and determines whether closed-squelch VAD is leaving too much on the table.
